basic_info.description: Spacious and Bright 5BR3BA House w/ 2 Door Garage! - This 2,900 sqft home features 5 bedrooms and 3 baths plus a low maintenance garden in Bayview. Upstairs hardwood floor throughout, a big skyline above stairs brings light to a spacious living room. Featuring 2 spacious bedrooms including a master suite and a game room. Lower level has marble floors installed, 3 good size bedrooms with sliding door closet, wet bar with granite countertops plus extra closet space, marble tile floors and a full bath with handheld showerhead over tub, 2-car parking garage plus washer-and-dryer on site. New garage door and motor to be replaced. House is conveniently located near San Bruno Ave's restaurants, shops, grocery stores, easy freeway access. Third St T light-rail to FiDi. Tenant pays All Utilities, i.e. Water, Garbage, PG&E and other services incurred. Must have good credit, and 3x rent income. 1 yr lease minimum. Cosigner welcome. No Smoking and no marijuana, please. Small pets OK with extra pet deposit (negotiable). (RLNE5448486)
